rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Web-Curl MCP server provides AI assistants with tools for web content retrieval and API interaction through a standardized interface. It offers three main capabilities: fetching webpage content with customizable resource blocking and authentication options, making REST API requests with various methods and headers, and performing Google Custom Search queries. Built with TypeScript and Puppeteer, it handles complex web scraping scenarios while managing timeouts, content extraction limits, and error handling. The implementation also includes a smart command feature that automatically detects URLs or search queries in natural language instructions, making it particularly useful for information retrieval, web automation, and content analysis tasks.
